item.title: Alibaba Ships Qwen App Update and Puts Wan 3.0 Into Public Test, With One Eye on Enterprise Buyers
item.description: Alibaba released five new features on the Qwen App on August 7, all powered by the new Qwen3.8-MAX flagship model and all free for now. item.title: L3 Is Just the Starting Line for China's AI-Agent Phones
item.description: Eleven mobile devices cleared the first batch of China's national AI-terminal intelligence grading tests in July, including nine smartphones from Huawei, Motorola, Honor, vivo, OPPO, Xiaomi and Stepfun. Vendors are calling L3 the highest level, but the real bottleneck for L4 is not model capability.

item.title: Inside the 800,000-Yuan Robot Trainer Job That Did Not Exist Three Years Ago
item.description: An embodied-AI robot application technician is one of 12 new occupations the Chinese Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security plans to add to the national catalog. Average salaries in the role already run between 500,000 and 800,000 yuan, and demand growth has been explosive.
